name: capture_air_traffic
description: Entity: Lynx. Capture over-the-air packets across all channels and interfaces into a temporary pcap file for 30s without disrupting the active connection, parse packet records, and sweep all Wi-Fi airspace channels.

seconds.description: Duration to sniff air packets (5..60, default 30)

fork.description: Detach into the background so the autonomy loop is not blocked
